source: Coordinates and listings from OpenTable restaurant pages (rating, hours, meta location), Wikipedia (St. Elmo Steakhouse, Indiana State Museum, Eiteljorg Museum, White River State Park), Downtown Indy, and indianamuseum.org / eiteljorg.org for admission and hours (Nov 2026)

spots.name: Soldiers' and Sailors' Monument
spots.blurb: The Civil War monument at the center of Monument Circle, the heart of downtown Indianapolis.
spots.blurbEs: El monumento a la Guerra Civil en el centro de Monument Circle, el corazón del centro de Indianápolis.

spots.name: Indiana State Museum
spots.blurb: Indiana's natural and cultural history museum on the Central Canal, open Wednesday to Sunday.
spots.blurbEs: El museo de historia natural y cultural de Indiana junto al Central Canal, abierto de miércoles a domingo.

spots.name: Eiteljorg Museum
spots.blurb: Museum of American Indian and Western art on the Central Canal, open daily (Sundays from noon).
spots.blurbEs: Museo de arte indígena americano y del Oeste junto al Central Canal, abierto todos los días (domingos desde el mediodía).

spots.name: White River State Park
spots.blurb: Downtown urban park along the White River and Central Canal that is home to several museums and the zoo.
spots.blurbEs: Parque urbano en el centro a lo largo del río White y el Central Canal, donde están varios museos y el zoológico.
